dataList.content: We extend our warmest welcome to the valued guests of Grand Magasin Sisyphe visiting today.

dataList.title: Grand Magasin Sisyphe
dataList.content: Grand Magasin Sisyphe is ever committed to cherishing every experience our customers procure within.

dataList.title: Grand Magasin Sisyphe
dataList.content: To keep abreast of the latest fashions, we actively encourage the wide variety of shops available at the department store to open and close according to trends. Please take care not to lose your way as you explore the establishment.

dataList.title: Grand Magasin Sisyphe
dataList.content: As always, restrooms on every floor are currently under repair. Please take note of this when planning your visit. We apologize for the inconvenience.

dataList.title: Grand Magasin Sisyphe
dataList.content: To prevent hygiene issues, entry to each floor will be limited to customers who have achieved the required Prestige Tier. Please visit our Customer Service Center on the sixth floor for any further queries.

dataList.title: Grand Magasin Sisyphe
dataList.content: Customers are welcome to make physical contact with all Mannequins on display. Conversely, Mannequins are also allowed to make physical contact with all customers. Should you wish to participate, please talk to the sales associate at the relevant shop, who will be delighted to assist you.

dataList.title: Grand Magasin Sisyphe
dataList.content: We ask everyone to do their best to ensure another day of worthwhile consumer experience for our customers. Thank you for choosing Grand Magasin Sisyphe, and enjoy your shopping.
